checks: Adversarial review: seven fixed, seven open and one deferred defect at application revision f4b9135. All requested attacks and limitations are listed in [repair review](test-audit/adversarial/REVIEW.md).
Full suite: 1,746 passed, zero unexpected failures or skipped cases, including 27 documented expected failures; 109.49 seconds. Evidence: [full suite](test-audit/adversarial/repair-unit-full.json).

Coverage suite: 1,746 passed in 118.04 seconds; configured thresholds passed. Statements 71.64%, branches 61.39%, functions 81.18%, lines 73.57%. Evidence: [coverage run](test-audit/adversarial/final-coverage-suite.json) and [summary](test-audit/adversarial/final-coverage-summary.json).
Typecheck, lint and npm run knip exit 0. Lint retains 23 warnings. Both real CLI CI scenarios pass. Evidence: [static and CI checks](test-audit/adversarial/final-static-ci-checks.json).

All six setup Docker scenarios pass against the packed CLI using ephemeral tmpfs fixture directories, without network or host mounts. The default run hit a full Docker overlay before four fixture directories could be created; both receipts are preserved. Evidence: [tmpfs replay](test-audit/adversarial/final-docker-tmpfs.json) and [default run](test-audit/adversarial/final-docker-setup.json).

The new-file coverage guard exits 2 for an unresolved base and 0 against the pinned baseline. The renamed local-storage workflow makes no network-share claim. Direct CI faults are killed. Evidence: [checks](test-audit/adversarial/final-static-ci-checks.json), [CI review](test-audit/adversarial/ci-review.json), [CI fault proofs](test-audit/adversarial/ci-http.results.json).

All 1,748 original declarations, 1,568 current declarations and 1,746 runtime cases reconcile with zero action, classification, source-body or mutation-proof gaps. Every original WEAK/HOLLOW rating retains surviving-fault evidence or an explicit structural reason. Evidence: [ledger](test-audit/ledger.json) and [reconciliation](test-audit/reconciliation.json).

Seven fixed defects have ordinary passing cases and current direct fault pass/fail/pass proofs. All 27 remaining expected-failure runtime cases fail as ordinary tests. D-G3-001 stays DEFERRED. Inverse repair unexpected passes receive no successful protection credit. Evidence: [acceptance](test-audit/adversarial/acceptance.json) and [ordinary failures](test-audit/adversarial/final-open-ordinary.json).

All ten original KNOWN_DEFECT matrix rows were restated from current evidence; the inventory remains 41 feature groups and 164 obligations. Evidence: [row-by-row restatus](test-audit/adversarial/feature-restatus.json).

Application bytes and modes match the frozen repair revision. Replaying only the nine listed application commits from completed audit ec19554 produces the same application tree; later application work is excluded. Evidence: [source integrity](test-audit/adversarial/final-source-integrity.json).

The v584 updateConfig and 50/100 ms read-test files remain byte-identical to the completed audit revision and pass. Evidence: [unchanged files](test-audit/adversarial/unchanged-compatibility-tests.json).

The report acceptance validator passes 24 controlled checks, including rejection of stale runtime data, unlisted application edits, inverse-only repair evidence and expected failures claimed as successful protection. Metadata generators produce identical output on replay. Evidence: [validator](test-audit/adversarial/report-validation.results.json) and [metadata replay](test-audit/adversarial/metadata-replay.json).

Behavior-over-implementation changed the VS Code fixtures to require the selected document ID and useful signal, and corrected the routing summary to expect cleared overrides. Build-the-lever produced reusable ordinary-defect reproduction, reconciliation and matrix update scripts.

blockers.description: First CI run watchlist: src/test/phase7b.read-paths.test.ts:104 requires reading 100 memories in under 100 ms; line124 requires FTS search in under 50 ms. Hosted-runner contention, scheduling and cold caches may exceed these wall-clock limits. Both assertions remain unchanged.

The default Docker run encountered a 100%-full overlay filesystem (0 bytes available, inodes48% used). Four scenarios failed while creating fixture directories. The same image and unchanged six tests passed with ephemeral tmpfs fixture directories. No Docker data was deleted; the normal local Docker runner remains capacity-limited.

Live provider credentials/services, native keychain and scheduler integration, a running VS Code extension host, native Windows path handling and physical network-share behavior were not exercised. Tests use local HTTP boundaries, host doubles, real subprocesses and isolated temporary storage. The feature matrix names these limits.
Verification used local macOS Node22.17.1 and the isolated Node22 Docker image. Other configured remote CI matrix combinations were not run; no push or PR was authorized.

The unresolved-base behavior is fixed. The coverage guard still skips added files absent from its coverage summary; the pinned-base pass adds no application modules and does not establish coverage for excluded modules. The original COLL-03 record is historical evidence; this is its remaining limit.
